Embedded report

Host-page content sits around a self-contained child document. The child is supplied inline through srcdoc, so it needs no network request and renders from file:// exactly as it would from a server.

Host panel, above the frame

An element in the parent document. A pin anchored here belongs to the host tree and is positioned in host coordinates.

Child document (srcdoc)

Host panel, below the frame

Content resuming in the parent document. Scrolling the host moves this panel while the child's internal scroll position stays where it was.
